findings.description: Large sections of ceiling and roof material are missing throughout the structure, with multiple openings visible in the overhead area allowing direct view of sky and exposed structural framing.
Structural roof framing members are fully exposed due to missing ceiling and roof covering materials across the entire overhead area.
Extensive debris consisting of broken wood framing, boards, and building materials scattered across the floor throughout the interior space.
Walls show extensive deterioration with large areas of damaged, stained, and deteriorated surface material. Multiple wall sections exhibit severe degradation.
